title: Appending Key to Array[Key] raises container type assertion
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.5.stable.official [876b29033], v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad]

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot v4.5.stable - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070

### Issue description

Running the following GDScript logs a seemingly incorrect container type assertion:
```gdscript
class Key:
    pass

func _init() -> void:
    var arr: Array[Key]
    arr.append(Key.new())
```
Executing `arr.append(Key.new())` will log:
```
0:0:1.16 | Attempted to push_back a variable of type 'Object' into a TypedArray of type 'int'.
container_type_validate.h:71
0:0:1.16 | Condition "!_p->typed.validate(value, "push_back")" is true.
array.cpp:281
```
The class being named `Key` is the key here (pun intended) - the assertion does not fail when it's named anything else (like `Key2`). It claims my array is typed `int` while it is typed `Key`.

Am I doing somethinig wrong here? Is `Key` some internal class I can't see that it mixes up? I didn't find anything in the documentation or other issues.

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new project.
- Create a scene of any root node type, add a script with any name.
- Paste in the GDScript code above.
- Debug the project, and note the logged assertions once passing the `arr.append(Key.new())` line.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[sample.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22584742/sample.zip)
